description: INDIANAPOLIS — State Rep. Andrew Ireland led a coalition of Indiana lawmakers in sending a letter to Indiana University demanding an immediate investigation into reports that an IU program allegedly partnered with a so-called charity tied to the radical Islamic terrorist group Hamas.
